home.noTrayTitle: No panel tray on this desktop
home.noTrayBody: Nothing on this session is showing StatusNotifierItem icons, so the countdown cannot appear in the panel. Prayer notifications and the adhan still work, and this window stays reachable.
home.noTrayFix: On GNOME, install the AppIndicator extension, then log out and back in:
home.searchCity: Search a city — English or العربية
home.cityHint: Searches a bundled offline list of about 70,000 cities. Nothing leaves the machine.
home.noCityBody: Try another spelling, or a nearby larger town. The database is bundled, so this works with no connection.

quran.nothingFoundBody: No verse contains “{query}”. Search ignores harakat, so الرحمن matches ٱلرَّحْمَٰن.
quran.notInstalled: The Quran database is not installed
quran.notInstalledBody: It is built from the bundled sources at package time. Run `npm run content` and rebuild the app.
quran.noSurahBody: Try an Arabic or Latin name, a number, or a reference like 2:255.

player.download: Download this surah for offline listening
player.blockedOffline: No recitation is downloaded for this surah, and there is no connection to fetch it.
player.blockedOnline: No recitation is downloaded for this surah yet. Download it to listen offline.

athkar.title: Athkar
athkar.nothingMatchesBody: Try part of a chapter title in Arabic.
athkar.notInstalledBody: They are built from the bundled source at package time. Run `npm run content` and rebuild.

qibla.title: Qibla
qibla.headingTitle: This dial does not know which way you are facing.
qibla.headingBody: A laptop has no magnetometer, so the app can only tell you the bearing, not your heading. Point a phone compass at {bearing}°, or at solar noon face your shadow and turn {bearing}° clockwise from straight ahead.
qibla.trueNorth: The bearing is from true north. A magnetic compass points to magnetic north, which differs from it by several degrees in most places — the app does not show that offset, because computing it offline needs a geomagnetic model it does not carry, and a guessed figure is worse than none.

calendar.adjustmentBody: This is the tabular calendar. Local moon sighting can differ from it by a day, so shift it to match your masjid.

settings.title: Settings
settings.startHidden: Start in the panel without a window
settings.trayDelay: Delay before the panel item appears
settings.closeToQuit: Closing the window quits the app
settings.letterSpacingArabic: Letter spacing is disabled for Arabic — it breaks the joins between letters.
settings.noFontconfig: fontconfig is not available, so only the bundled fonts are listed.

about.title: About the data
about.intro: Every bundled text keeps its source and licence. Nothing here is generated, and nothing is fetched at runtime.
about.sajdaNote: All 15 sajda markers are rendered. Schools differ on whether 14 or 15 of them are recited prostrations; the app marks them all rather than choosing a side.
about.athkarNote: The publisher’s feed carries the text and repeat count only, so hadith references and benefit notes are absent rather than sourced elsewhere.
